“A dream that once seemed impossible — and now it’s a reality.”

Joyous and grateful, we open our doors to you. When our family moved from El Salvador to the United States, we wanted to keep our culture alive in our hearts — bound by love, faith, and home-cooked meals.

Our years in the kitchen show up in every plate. We guarantee that one bite will transport you straight to our beautiful country. Join us on this journey, and as we say back home…

Al mudarnos de El Salvador a los Estados Unidos queríamos mantener viva nuestra cultura. Nuestros años de experiencia en la cocina se reflejarán en nuestra comida. Únete a nosotros en este emocionante viaje.

El Menú · Breakfast · Lunch · Dinner

Hand-patted & griddle-toasted

Every pupusa comes with our house curtido (tangy cabbage slaw) and warm salsa roja. Pupusas are naturally gluten-free.

* Items may be prepared with raw ingredients and/or cooked to order. Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness.
